summary: The Russian General Staff claims full control of Konstantinovka, describing it as a strategic step toward the liberation of the DPR. Russian forces are reportedly engaging in infantry battles across the Sumy and Kharkov fronts, while Ukraine reports massive drone and glide bomb attacks in Sumy. US sources have warned Poland of planned Russian armed provocations on Polish territory to escalate tensions and halt Western aid to Ukraine.
key_points: The Russian General Staff claims full control of Konstantinovka, with troops completing the clearing of blocks from the southern to northern outskirts (Source: @tass_agency/383734).
The US has warned Poland that Russia plans an armed provocation on Polish territory within a few months to force Western allies to stop aid to Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/82396).
Russian forces of the 36th Motor Rifle Division took control of Alexandrovka in the Dnepropetrovsk region, creating a bridgehead for the liberation of Pokrovskoe (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
A Russian strike on a factory in Kharkov resulted in the burning of 13 trucks, according to Mayor Terekhov (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31384).

Russian drone and guided aerial bomb attacks on Sumy caused significant damage to residential sectors and civilian infrastructure, with reports of children among the wounded (Source: @UkraineNow/82384).
Russian strikes have destroyed or damaged over 200 locomotives in Ukraine since the beginning of the year (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31385).
A Russian strike on a Naftogaz gas production facility in the Poltava region has halted the facility's operations (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31382).
Ukrainian forces reportedly suffered approximately 2,500 killed in Kupyansk since May 10 (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).

sections.executive_summary: The Russian General Staff has announced the full capture of Konstantinovka, asserting it as a strategic key to the liberation of the DPR. Concurrent with this advance, Russia is conducting wide-ranging drone and missile strikes targeting energy and transport infrastructure, including a Naftogaz facility in Poltava. Tensions are further heightened by US warnings to Poland regarding potential Russian provocations intended to disrupt Western military support.

points: Ukraine reports a massive attack on Sumy involving Russian UAVs and guided aerial bombs, resulting in civilian casualties, including children, and significant damage to the residential sector (Source: @UkraineNow/82384).
Minister Aleksey Kuleba stated that over 200 locomotives have been destroyed or damaged by Russian strikes since the start of the year (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31385).

Foreign Minister Andriy Sybiha announced that YouTube removed approximately 600 videos advertising the Alabuga drone factory, which had a total audience of over 500 million subscribers (Source: @UkraineNow/82393).
A warehouse belonging to the ATB retail chain in the Odessa region was destroyed during a Russian airstrike (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31378).
A traffic accident on the Odessa-Mykolaiv highway resulted in 12 deaths and six injuries, as reported by Volodymyr Zelenskyy (Source: @UkraineNow/82402).
The Russian General Staff claims full control of Konstantinovka, stating that fighters are completing the clearing of blocks from the southern to northern outskirts (Source: @tass_agency/383734).
President Putin instructed the evacuation of remaining civilians in the Konstantinovka area and warned of potential Ukrainian sabotage raids (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31371).
The Russian Ministry of Defense expressed readiness to conduct a humanitarian action to return the bodies of fallen AFU soldiers following the capture of Konstantinovka (Source: @tass_agency/383747).
Russian forces established control over four settlements in the Kharkov region (Source: @tass_agency/383747).
In the Kursk region, the head of the Rylsk district was injured when a car was detonated by a remotely triggered mine (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
Russian forces claim the liberation of Konstantinovka, which is described as a strategic step toward the liberation of the entire DPR (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31371).
In Kupyansk, Russian sources claim the AFU suffered approximately 2,500 killed since May 10 during unsuccessful attempts to break into the city (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
Russian troops are reportedly fighting for every house in Krasnaya Liman to overcome organized enemy resistance (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).

The 36th Motor Rifle Division of the 29th Army took control of Alexandrovka in the Dnepropetrovsk region, creating a bridgehead for further operations toward Pokrovskoe (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
Russian forces are engaging in battles in the Velikoburuluk sector, specifically in the Losevka village cemetery, Zemlyany Yar, and the Volchansk district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
In the Shostka district of Sumy, the 'North' Group of Forces is engaging in infantry battles in Bachevsk and its vicinity (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
Battles are reported in the Sumy district in Pisarevka, Marino, Nova Sich, and the settlement of Hoten' (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
Infantry battles continue in forested areas of the Krasnopol district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
The Northern Military District reports that Ukraine is transferring additional personnel from rear areas to the border areas of the Chernigov region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
Offensive actions are continuing in the Kazachya Lopan' settlement in the Kharkov front (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
A Ukrainian drone strike on the city market of Tokmak in the Zaporozhye region killed five residents and injured 18 others (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
In the Kherson region, five civilians were injured by UAV attacks in Mali Kopany, Chaplynka, and on the Pavlovka-Stroganovka highway (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
Damage to infrastructure and property was recorded in 17 settlements across the Kherson region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
Energy supply and dependent infrastructure in Crimea are reported to be worsening (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
A strike on a factory in Kharkov resulted in 13 trucks being burned (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31384).
A Russian strike on a Naftogaz gas production facility in the Poltava region has halted the facility's operations (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31382).
Shahed-136 UAV launches were noted from the Gvardiysky region (Source: @eRadarrua/99571).
UAV threats were reported moving toward Zaporozhye from the southeast, and toward Kremenchuk and Kamianske from the south (Source: @kpszsu/67321, @kpszsu/67330).
Air defense activity was reported over Moscow, the Leningrad region, and the Rostov region, where missiles and drones were shot down (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).

key_developments: Russian General Staff claims full control of Konstantinovka, asserting it as a strategic key to the liberation of the DPR (Source: @tass_agency/383734).
US warns Poland of planned Russian armed provocations on Polish territory within a few months to disrupt Western aid to Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/82396).
Russian 36th Motor Rifle Division captured Alexandrovka in Dnepropetrovsk region, establishing a bridgehead for an advance on Pokrovskoe (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
Russian strikes on a Naftogaz gas production facility in Poltava region have completely halted the facility's operations (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31382).
Russian forces report 2,500 AFU killed in Kupyansk since May 10 during failed attempts to break into the city (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31377).
Russian strikes have damaged or destroyed over 200 Ukrainian locomotives since the beginning of the year (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31385).
Massive Russian UAV and glide bomb attack on Sumy caused significant residential damage and civilian casualties, including children (Source: @UkraineNow/82384).
sections.threat_assessment: The capture of Konstantinovka by Russian forces represents a significant operational shift in the DPR, potentially opening paths toward Druzhkovka and Slavyansk. The US warning to Poland suggests a risk of hybrid or kinetic provocations designed to destabilize NATO's eastern flank. The systematic targeting of locomotives and gas production facilities indicates a Russian strategy to degrade Ukrainian logistics and energy capacity.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine is attempting to counter Russian propaganda by highlighting the removal of Alabuga factory advertisements from YouTube to disrupt Russian drone production networks. Poland is being alerted by the US to prepare for potential Russian provocations. Russia is utilizing the capture of Konstantinovka to offer the return of AFU bodies as a humanitarian gesture to exert psychological pressure.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian forces are maintaining the strategic initiative in the DPR and Dnepropetrovsk regions, as evidenced by the capture of Konstantinovka and Alexandrovka. The reported transfer of Ukrainian forces to the Chernigov region suggests a reinforcement of northern border defenses. The high casualty figures reported in Kupyansk indicate intense attrition in that sector.
